cases.rationale: The requested outcome is an explanation, so the category is answer. One owner can finish a bounded explanation from one pasted paragraph, which is the direct family. direct allows only solo.

Hard negative: the request names a team, which tempts explore-build or parallel delivery. The outcome is still one bounded answer from a single pasted sentence, and one owner can carry it. Extra people would only move that sentence around. direct allows only solo.

The outcome is an answer. The current bottleneck is two substantial unknowns with separate sources, notes, and checks, so the family is explore-build. That family allows only parallel discovery before one owner synthesizes.

The outcome is an answer. The second unit cannot start from an agreed interface; it needs the first unit's accepted artifact. That is coordinated-delivery with a sequential handoff, not parallel discovery.

The outcome is an answer that will be quoted publicly. A wrong figure is a consequential acceptance risk, so a separately briefed evaluator of the sentence is justified. independent-review allows only generator-evaluator.

The outcome is an answer. A wrong public statement is a consequential acceptance risk, and the check is a separately briefed evaluator of the draft rather than another author. independent-review allows only generator-evaluator.

The outcome is an answer. The work is interruptible and needs the durable ledger, so the family is adaptive-controller even though no optimization is authorized. The current stage is one coupled unit, so the topology is solo. Durable delivery does not require a benchmark.

The outcome is a reader-facing FAQ, so the category is answer. Deciding fact: the owner must reselect the ready set from the durable ledger after interruption, and the request forbids freezing the two current questions into a standing pair. That requirement is adaptive-controller. Parallel is only the stage the ledger shows now. coordinated-delivery would apply only if those ready branches and their interface were themselves the delivery plan. No optimization is authorized. adaptive-controller allows the current topology to be parallel.

Hard negative: two topics tempt explore-build. Both passages are already supplied and one owner can check them, so the transfer cost of a second investigator is the whole task. The outcome is a short research note, and direct allows only solo.

Hard negative: a timing result tempts an adaptive-controller optimization campaign. There is no correctness baseline and the measurements are not comparable, so optimization is not authorized. The outcome is a bounded research note for one owner: direct and solo.
The outcome is research. Two substantial independent unknowns have separate sources and checks, so the family is explore-build, whose only topology is parallel discovery before one synthesis.

Hard negative: two unfinished notes tempt a concurrent pair. The signature note is blocked on the retry-rules note's accepted glossary, so the branches are not ready. coordinated-delivery uses sequential for an accepted-artifact handoff. The outcome is research because the deliverables are cited notes from posted carrier documents, not a code change.

The outcome is research. The questions and interface are already fixed, and the two memos are ready independent branches, so this is coordinated-delivery in parallel rather than explore-build discovery.

The outcome is research. The note will be quoted publicly, so acceptance risk justifies a separately briefed evaluator of the artifact. independent-review allows only generator-evaluator. The author's own confidence is not the check.

The outcome is research. Interruptible work that must keep a source ledger is adaptive-controller. The current stage is one owner and one coupled citation, so the topology is solo. Continuity is not a measured-optimization campaign.

The outcome is research. The two statutes are substantial independent unknowns, not ready branches with a fixed interface. explore-build allows only parallel discovery before one owner synthesizes the note.

Hard negative: disjoint files tempt coordinated-delivery in parallel. Each change is a few characters of tightly coupled copy, and one owner can carry both through acceptance with less handoff than two branches. direct allows only solo.

Hard negative: a baseline and a benchmark tempt adaptive-controller measured optimization. Optimization was forbidden, so the authorized work is one owner's bounded implementation assessment. That is direct and solo.

The outcome is implementation, but the current bottleneck is two substantial independent unknowns. explore-build is parallel discovery before one owner synthesizes any later build. The build itself is not this stage.

Hard negative: different files tempt a parallel branch. The consumer is blocked on an unresolved shared invariant, so the interface is not ready. coordinated-delivery uses sequential accepted-artifact handoff. The outcome is implementation.
The outcome is implementation. Both branches are ready, the interface is fixed, and the write scopes are disjoint, so coordinated-delivery uses parallel with one integration owner.

The outcome is implementation. Cross-site data exposure is a consequential acceptance risk, so a separately briefed evaluator of the actual behavior is required. independent-review allows only generator-evaluator.

The outcome is implementation. The session can be interrupted and must keep a durable record of an external send, so the family is adaptive-controller. One ready coupled unit means the current topology is solo. Delivery continuity is not optimization.

The outcome is a change to the webhook, so the category is implementation. Deciding fact: the owner must reselect the blocked unit from the checkpoint after interruption, and the request forbids freezing the parser-then-caller order as a standing plan. That requirement is adaptive-controller. Sequential is only the stage the checkpoint shows now. coordinated-delivery would apply only if that accepted-artifact handoff were the plan. adaptive-controller allows sequential as the current stage.

The outcome is debug. Two substantial independent evidence questions remain, with disjoint notes and no shared fix yet. explore-build applies, and its only topology is parallel discovery before one owner chooses a change.

Hard negative: two failing commands tempt explore-build. The evidence is one shared function the owner already has, so a second investigation duplicates the same context. The outcome is debug, and the family is direct with solo.
The outcome is debug. Two substantial independent unknowns remain, with disjoint evidence and no shared patch yet. explore-build is parallel discovery before one owner chooses the fix.
The outcome is debug. The second unit needs the first unit's accepted artifact, so coordinated-delivery is sequential. The units are not independent unknowns that can be explored together.
The outcome is debug. The fixtures are ready independent branches with an agreed report format and disjoint paths, so coordinated-delivery uses parallel. They are not a generator and an evaluator.

The outcome is debug. A customer-visible money error is a consequential acceptance risk, and the evaluator must see the artifact and the failing sale rather than the author's story. independent-review allows only generator-evaluator.

Sequential is only the stage the file shows now. coordinated-delivery would apply only if that handoff were the plan. adaptive-controller allows sequential as the current stage.

Hard negative: the word independent tempts independent-review. The change is one bounded line with the evidence attached, and there is no consequential acceptance risk or observed self-review gap that justifies another person. direct and solo.
The outcome is a review, and the bottleneck is two substantial independent evidence unknowns. explore-build covers that discovery in parallel before one owner writes the finding.
The outcome is a review. The second deliverable waits on the first deliverable's accepted artifact. coordinated-delivery uses sequential for that handoff.

Hard negative: two review branches tempt independent-review. Neither branch evaluates the other's artifact; both are ready peer deliverables with a fixed rubric and disjoint paths. That is coordinated-delivery in parallel. The category remains review.
The outcome is a review of a consequential runbook. A separately briefed evaluator must see the artifact and the original criteria. independent-review allows only generator-evaluator.

The outcome is a check of existing grant claims against a rubric, so the category is review. Deciding fact: the owner must reselect the open item from the durable ledger after interruption, and the request forbids treating the current separate check as a one-sitting assignment. That requirement is adaptive-controller. generator-evaluator is only the stage the ledger shows now. coordinated-delivery does not fit: there is no accepted-artifact handoff and no pair of ready branches, and that family does not allow generator-evaluator. independent-review would fit only a single consequential check with no reselection.
The outcome is a review, and the bottleneck is two substantial independent evidence unknowns. explore-build covers that discovery in parallel before one reviewer writes the finding.

Hard negative: the epic title tempts adaptive-controller. The approved decision is one reversible choice with the rule already pasted, and no durable state is required. The outcome is design, the family is direct, and the topology is solo.

That requirement is adaptive-controller. Sequential is only the stage the log shows now. coordinated-delivery would apply only if that handoff were the plan. adaptive-controller allows sequential as the current stage.
